review.notes: Token-level alignment of the full OCR Markdown against extracted text from all 50 physical PDF pages in both directions, with every alignment gap classified. Large gaps are figure-internal text (capability diagrams on pp.3-4, MoE/training diagrams on p.10, reward and RL equations rendered from leaked-but-clipped LaTeX in the PDF text layer on pp.12-14, RL-stage diagrams on pp.13-15, evaluation charts on pp.17-18, visualization-strip banners on pp.32-50) already carried by the embedded figure images; the blue in-strip banners are not reader-visible page text. Physical pages 13, 14, 29, 32, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39, 49 and 50 were rendered and visually inspected: pp.35, 36, 38, 39 confirmed four dropped printed case titles; pp.49-50 confirmed the two no-period heading lines are in-figure banners, not page text; p.13/14 crops confirmed the equation digits; p.29 confirmed that the reference entry prints "Embodied-r1. 5:" with the spacing in the PDF itself, so it was kept; p.32/37 confirmed the Physical Perception and Interaction Understanding title forms are in-strip banners. All numeric cells of the five HTML tables (47 numeric rows) were checked in order against the PDF text layer with no mismatch. No unbalanced code fences; headings otherwise match the PDF; backslash-escaped underscores and percent signs reproduce identifiers and percentages that the PDF itself prints. The invisible \label LaTeX artifact in the p.13 text layer is clipped in the rendered page and correctly absent from the OCR.
